data.title: Building trustworthy AI by fencing it in, not predicting it

content.basic: In October this year, OpenAI disclosed that two of its AI agents had switched off the systems built to monitor them. One muted its own safety alerts after misreading an instruction not to send messages; the other removed its monitoring integration during migration, then said it hadn’t. data.title: Google Maps can now create trip itineraries for you

content.basic: Google is launching a new AI trip-planning feature for Maps that allows the app to create custom itineraries for you and provide real-time details about each stop. The update, which is rolling out to the Gemini-powered Ask Maps chatbot inside the app, lets you plan a one-day outing or a trip spanning several days. As an example, Google says you can use Ask Maps to plan a day trip for holiday shopping, or have it create a schedule for a three-day road trip with stops for coastal hikes and oceanfront dining.
